title: TwinVPN — Reason codes by domain
description: Every panel here keys on the CODE, never on the text. ADR-0015 §11.2 rule 4: 'the code is the contract; the human text is not' - summary and next-action strings may be reworded or re-translated at any time, so automation, tests and support tooling MUST key on the code. docs/testing-strategy.md V9 makes that a review rule. The 16 domains are a CLOSED SET (contracts/registry/reason_codes.json closed_domain_set); a code from outside it is a contract-test failure, not a dashboard gap.

list.name: domain
list.description: NET NAT RELAY AUTH CRYPTO PROTO POLICY DNS ROUTE PLATFORM RESOURCE CONTROL INTERNAL MGMT STORE UPDATE

panels.title: Reason-code frequency by DOMAIN
panels.description: Domain is the only segment with registry meaning: forward compatibility is by DOMAIN prefix (ADR-0015 §11.2 rule 5), so a receiver meeting an unknown code degrades on its first segment. Grouping here by domain therefore matches how an older peer would actually understand the traffic.

panels.title: INTERNAL-domain share (ADR-0015 §14 revisit condition 5)
panels.description: REVISIT TRIGGER, not a vanity metric. 'More than 5% of support cases resolve with a reason_code in the INTERNAL domain, or with no reason_code at all' falsifies the completeness of the taxonomy and requires the registry to be expanded and the unenterable-without-a-reason enforcement to be audited. Every INTERNAL occurrence is by definition a defect (§11.2.1).

panels.title: Emissions carrying NO reason_code
panels.description: This must be ZERO. ADR-0015 O-05 makes emission a property of the TRANSITION ITSELF, not of a call site, and §11.6 mechanism 3 makes DEGRADED, BLOCKED, RECONNECTING and FAILED UNENTERABLE without a reason_code - a transition without one is INTERNAL.INVARIANT_VIOLATED. A non-zero value here means the choke point has been bypassed.

panels.title: Reason-code rate by code, per domain
Codes by registry attributes (class / severity / terminal / user-actionable)
panels.description: ADR-0015 §11.2 rule 5 requires every carrier of a Diagnostic to transmit the registry attributes FOR UNRECOGNISED CODES AS WELL AS KNOWN ONES, because 'a receiver cannot choose a correct affordance from a bare string, and could not tell a POLICY-class condition that must not be dismissible from an INFO one that should be transient'. A row here with an empty class or severity means a carrier dropped them, which is a contract defect.

targets.expr: sum by (twinvpn_reason_code, twinvpn_reason_domain, twinvpn_reason_class, twinvpn_severity, twinvpn_terminal, twinvpn_user_actionable, twinvpn_remediation_class, twinvpn_scope) (increase(twinvpn_reason_code_total{twinvpn_reason_domain=~"$domain"}[$__range]))

panels.title: RELAY and CONTROL domains, split by address family
panels.description: Address family is an EVIDENCE FIELD, never a namespace (ADR-0015 §11.2, rejecting TVPN-IPV4/TVPN-IPV6). So a v4 failure and a v6 failure are the SAME condition with different evidence, and this panel splits by the evidence rather than by a per-family code - which is why neither family can acquire a diagnostic vocabulary the other lacks.
